text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally the day of filming… Yukino Bijin and I go out to relax for a little while, then head to the filming location.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Over here, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City! Hi! Thanks for com'n along to watch!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, I had some time on my hands… So, how do you feel? Think you've got this?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I sure do! I'm gonna put all that train'n we did to work!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Actor A
text_block_list.text: You mean she was practicing here all this time?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-yes… She told me that, even if her injury keeps her from running especially well… she just can't shake off her desire to run.

text_block_list.name: Actor A
text_block_list.text: …So she didn't give up after all.

text_block_list.name: Actor A
text_block_list.text: I think I'll go talk to her one more time… Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, she did pretty well. Her voice projected nicely, and her posture was strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Judging from that solid performance, it looks like Yukino Bijin's intense training really paid off.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Aaand cut! Good work today, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you kindly!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: You did good, Yukino. I think you might just be as cut out for acting as you are for racing.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Heh… Well, I did rehearse a whole bunch! After all, if I'm gonna be a proper actor, I gotta know how t'properly act!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: I really appreciate the professionalism! And I can't wait to see what you accomplish in the future!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: …Oh, I almost forgot! How would you like a part in another show? I'd love to give you a role with more lines!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? I… I…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I thought that if I performed with real actors, I'd get a little bit closer to hav'n the strength and beauty they do…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So if I keep doing this, maybe it'll bring me just a itsy bit closer t'becom'n a true city girl…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: In that case… if there's another opp'rtunity wait'n for me…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'd sure like t'step up to the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'd love that! I'll show you an even more wonderful me next time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer! City! We've finished film'n!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Great job, Yukino. And it sounds like you just got offered another role, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yep!
choice_data_list: Guess I better reward you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yep!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gee whiz! Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Like a wrap party that's also a "congratulations on your next gig" party? I'm in. Is there anywhere in particular you'd like to go?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Let's go to a coffee shop for a fancy drink!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I put so much effort into my rehearsal and prep'ration that even the director said I did a good job…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Someth'n tells me I'm extra city girl-like t'day!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Which means no matter how compl'cated our drink orders are, I'll be able t'say it easy-peasy!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wow, look at you, all fearless. I'll leave it all to you, then.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we head off to celebrate with a Yukino Bijin brimming with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Absolutely! I've gotta make sure I do even better than t'day next time!
choice_data_list: I'll do everything I can to support you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow, thanks so much! And I want you t'be even stricter this time, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, trust, our sessions are gonna keep getting harder. You might end up being my rival, so I'm training you with that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Your r-rival?! W-well, that's just what I wanted t'hear! In fact, I'm ready t'go train right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wow, you really mean business… But so do I.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They set off to train… and I chase after them, eager to lend them both my support.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-hey, don't go teas'n with me like that, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Heh. There's the Yukino Bijin we know and love.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But there is some truth to what your trainer said. The ability to work steadily towards your dreams is a talent in its own right.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Unless you're a true natural, you'll never reach the top without hard work. Which means that as long as you keep at it…
choice_data_list: You'll be able to shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Y'know, I had this thought when you two first encouraged me t'act, and now that I've done it again, it's popped into m'head again.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I realized dream'n alone won't bring those dreams to life… but if you pluck up the courage t'take that first step, you can really do anyth'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna keep mov'n forwards! I gotta if I want t'shine even brighter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't help being enchanted by the twinkle in Yukino Bijin's eye as she speaks.
